description: This file defines custom exception classes for handling various service-related errors in the application, including not found, unauthorized, forbidden, and conflict errors.

classes.name: ServiceError
classes.description: Base class for business/service errors, extending the built-in Exception class, with attributes for message, code, optional details, and HTTP status.

classes.name: NotFoundError
classes.description: Raised when an entity is not found; inherits from ServiceError, sets HTTP 404.

classes.name: UnauthorizedError
classes.description: Raised when authentication fails; inherits from ServiceError, sets HTTP 401.

classes.name: ForbiddenError
classes.description: Raised when a user is not permitted to perform an action; inherits from ServiceError, sets HTTP 403.

classes.name: ConflictError
classes.description: Raised when a conflict occurs, such as a constraint violation; inherits from ServiceError, sets HTTP 409.

methods.name: __init__(self, message: str = "Conflict", details: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Initializes each error class with a message, optional details, and sets specific error code and HTTP status.
